test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 09 Feb 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which railway station was awarded 'Eat Right Station' certification with a 4-star rating, in November 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhopal Junction Railway Station.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bhopal Railway Station** has been awarded a **4-star 'Eat Right Station' certification** for providing high-quality, nutritious food to passengers in November 2022.
 
• The station has received a **5-star rating indicating full compliance with safe and hygienic food regulations** for passengers.
 
• Other Railway Stations with this Certification: **Anand Vihar Terminal Railway Station(Delhi)**, **Chhatrapati Shivaji Terminus(Mumbai)**, **Mumbai Central Railway Station, (Mumbai)**, **Vadodara Railway Station(Gujarat)**, and **Chandigarh Railway Station.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Eat Right Station certification** is a program launched **by **the **Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI)** in **2018 **to promote food safety and hygiene at railway stations.
 
• The certification is part of the **'Eat Right India' movement.**
 
• The certification is awarded to railway stations based on their compliance with food safety and hygiene standards, availability of healthy food options, and promotion of healthy eating habits among passengers.
 
• The certification has** five levels** - 1-star, 2-star, 3-star, and 4-star and 5-star with 5-star being the highest rating.
